structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. With 500 a month for ten years the page says I'd be left with about 84,000 at that "אינטראקטיב" company I've never heard of, but only about 68,000–71,000 at Leumi, Hapoalim or Discount. So I'll ask you, and then go to my bank to bargain like the page says, rather than open anything at a company I don't know.

stuck.why: 'להשקיע במדד': to me מדד is the price index on the news, so at first I didn't know what the page was about
84,184 under 'הבחירה שלכם' and 86,492 in green under 'הזוג הזול ביותר'. I didn't understand what I had chosen, or what a 'זוג' is
A long list of English fund names with coloured tags and red minus signs. I couldn't tell which one is 'the fund'
Long paragraphs in small grey letters under each company. I gave up on them
